kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننعدم (form VII)
# نَنْعَدِمُ (nanʕadimu) /nan.ʕa.di.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# نَنْعَدِمَ (nanʕadima) /nan.ʕa.di.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# نَنْعَدِمْ (nanʕadim) /nan.ʕa.dim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
